values.note: Standard sites $50 a night weekdays, $55 weekends, $65 on holiday weekends and weeks (Memorial Day, the week of July 4, Family Camp week, Labor Day, the first two October weekends); premium sites $85; reduced in April, May, September and October. $235 a week, $785 a month; seasonal packages $3,250-4,950. Two car passes included per site; extra cars $10. A 50% non-refundable deposit at booking.

note: Large RV campground run by Covenant Hills Camp & Retreat, a Christian youth/family camp near Otisville, open to the public by the night alongside the camp's own programs. Beach and lake access, game room, golf-cart rental, weekly activities Memorial Day-Labor Day. Ministry-run: no alcohol, marijuana or drugs anywhere in the campground. Gated entrance; every car needs a pass. --Claude
summary: Camp's own pages: standard $50 weekday / $55 weekend / $65 holiday, premium $85 (high 55 -> 85); 321 full-hookup 50-amp sites (count 324 -> 321), 55 pull-throughs to 50 ft, 12 tent sites; showers, paid Wi-Fi; open Apr 1-Oct 31; nightly/weekly online on Firefly, monthly/seasonal by phone. Ordinary public nights confirmed (not retreat/member-only). Seasonal: 'over 100' of 321 sites offered for seasonal lease (roughly a third). Price gate: $50 base, at the line; the family has not stayed. Dropped rates and the RV Life line from the note.
flags: Price gate: base standard site $50 weekdays ($55 weekends) on the camp's own page, at the US$50 line; no gateway within 40 km (Detroit 104 km). No mandatory per-night fee (two car passes included).
